comment: Packages found on Android TV and Google TV devices (Google TV Streamer, Chromecast with Google TV, TV boxes and TVs). Conservative: a TV has no recovery screen a normal user can reach, so anything near setup, input, the remote or the home screen is locked or HIGH.

locked.reason: Google TV home screen. Without it the device has no launcher.
Android TV home screen. Some devices factory-reset settings on the next boot without it.
TV Settings app: needed to change anything, including undoing Prune's changes.
TV setup. Removing it breaks sound and volume settings on some TVs.
Infrared service: needed for the remote to control TV volume and power.
TV channel database used by the home screen and live TV inputs.

com.google.android.tv.dfuservice.note: Firmware updates for the remote. Keep it, or the remote can stay on buggy firmware.

com.google.android.tv.remote.service.note: Pairing with the Google TV phone remote and the Google Home app.

com.google.android.katniss.note: Google voice search and Assistant on TV. The remote's microphone button stops working.

com.google.android.tvrecommendations.note: Android TV Core Services: content rows on the home screen. Some launchers misbehave without it.

com.google.android.apps.tv.dreamx.note: Ambient mode (photo screensaver). The TV uses the plain Android screensaver instead.

android.autoinstalls.config.google.sabri.note: Installs partner apps during first setup. Not used afterwards.
